messages.subject: [Fedora-r-devel-list] Request for rpy1 in Fedora
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
	I got a request for rpy1 in Fedora:
	https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=528664

	I am seriously considering to provide it (submitting a new package) on the 
basis that the two versions are installable side by side and there are no 
conflicts on a file level.

	Would anyone oppose such a move for F11+?

	Regards,
-- 
José Abílio
